claims.claim_text: Executive technology leader aligns alliance growth, regulated modernization, and platform productization around decisions that connect enterprise AI adoption to business value.
From that commercial base, IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization become coordinated partner execution with a clear platform agenda.
Against that operating foundation, release automation and security scanning were embedded in regulated modernization delivery paths, with control integrated into execution.
In parallel, alliance operating cadence supported 20% joint revenue growth, linking partner execution to measurable commercial accountability.
That platform discipline also generated $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and scaling the team, tying productization to investment decisions.
Future partner architecture leadership can unite joint solution development and platform growth with governed delivery and commercial accountability.
